input: All 12 freshly generated games, including any capped games; no outcome-based exclusions
roots: 4 per total-alive stratum: 2, 3-4, 5-6; minimum hashed state identity, distinct games within each stratum; idle joint move requests with >1 choice each; all archived prefix keys must reproduce
depth3_selection: first 2 hash-ranked retained roots in each stratum, before timing
order: rotate three arms each repeat; independent cold caches
leaf: current default eval01; actual terminal outcomes override
sample_identity: seed=hash(state_key128,remaining_depth,row,column,sample_index,0x5a17); same sampled finite game regardless of traversal
ordering: candidates only, fully charged one-step first-sample matrix at internal nodes
numerical_check: value difference and root strategy exploitability in full reference matrix <1e-7
go_bar: all checks pass; complete all retained roots; candidate >=1.5x geometric-mean speedup at depth2 and faster on >=75% of roots; depth3 is a prespecified secondary check, not grounds to silently replace failed primary gate
scope: feasibility only; fixed perfect-information sampled games, one sample seed; no MCTS duel, strength claim, public publication or product modification
smoke: first selected root at depth2, 1 repeat; excluded from main statistics
